Unmortgaging could set up future hotel builds, but hotels require returning 4 houses per property group to the bank once I have even coverage, and I'm now checking unmortgage costs starting with Pennsylvania.

The greens, yellows, and orange groups are mostly owned by player 4, so unmortgaging those spots mainly just restores modest base rents rather than opening up bigger plays. Since Gemini holds $418 and rents on these cheap properties are small anyway, I'll unmortgage St James and Tennessee for $198 total, leaving me $161 as a buffer.
